references.text: Prohibition against stealing, lying, or deceiving one another - fundamental principle of honesty in dealings with one's neighbor
Prohibition against exploiting or robbing one's neighbor - the same ethical principle regarding fair treatment
Reiteration of the prohibition against exploiting one another, with an addition about fear of God as motivation
Prohibition against taking interest from one's brother - principle of fair economic treatment of fellow countrymen
Prohibition against exploiting poor workers - protection of the vulnerable in economic transactions
False weights are an abomination to the Lord - principle of honesty in trade
Prophetic accusation against those who take interest and exploit their neighbor for profit
Paul exhorts not to exploit or deceive one's brother in business
